title: Materials · Calculations
final_note: You worked through the key terms in Materials.

concepts.def: Long chains of repeating monomer units.
Mixtures of a metal with other elements, usually harder than the pure metal.
Hard, brittle, insulating materials such as clay and glass.
Two materials combined for improved properties (e.g. fibreglass).
Strength, hardness, conductivity chosen to suit a use.
Very small particles with a high surface area and special properties.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Materials — a core area of GCSE Chemistry.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Materials brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Materials.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Sodium has atomic number 11. Its electron configuration is:
An atom of Mg loses 2 electrons to form Mg²⁺. Its number of protons is:
What does a mole of a substance represent?
options: A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
Avogadro's number (6.02 x 10^23) of particles of that substance.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
A mole is a unit of mass equal to the relative molecular mass in grams of any substance.

mcqs.q: At room temperature and pressure, what volume does 1 mole of any gas occupy?
options: Approximately 24 dm^3 (24,000 cm^3), regardless of the identity of the gas.
Heavier gases occupy a smaller volume per mole because their particles are denser.
Different gases occupy completely different volumes proportional to their molar mass.
The new concentration is 2 mol/dm^3 because adding water makes the solution stronger.

mcqs.q: If 50 cm^3 of a 1 mol/dm^3 solution is diluted to 100 cm^3, what is the new concentration?
options: The new concentration is 0.05 mol/dm^3 because you doubled the volume so you halve the concentration once and shift the decimal too.
The new concentration is 2 mol/dm^3 because adding water makes the solution stronger.
A mole is a unit of volume equal to 24 dm^3 at any temperature.
0.5 mol/dm^3 — the moles stay the same but the volume doubled.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Electron configuration”?
options: Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Relative atomic mass”?
options: Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Mass number”?
options: Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.
Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Ion”?
options: Total number of protons and neutrons in the nucleus.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atom”?
options: Average mass of atoms of an element compared to 1/12 the mass of a C-12 atom.
Smallest unit of an element; consists of a nucleus of protons and neutrons surrounded by electrons.
Number of protons in the nucleus; defines the element.
Atom or group of atoms with an overall charge from losing or gaining electrons.

mcqs.q: Which of these is the best definition of “Atomic number”?

Arrangement of electrons in shells: 2, 8, 8 for the first three shells.

mcqs.q: How many neutrons in an atom with mass number 23 and atomic number 11?
options: 12 neutrons
10 neutrons
14 neutrons
11 neutrons
